title: Strategic priority sprint blueprint — company-wide planning draft
summary: This working draft captures a lean, three-month sprint blueprint to align exec priorities, surface cross-team tradeoffs, and define the company-level OKR scaffold we will take into the all-hands. It is intentionally terse — use this as the source for discussion at the leadership offsite and the March all-hands.
context_and_problem_statement: We need a clear set of company-level priorities to guide routing of scarce engineering effort (serving runtime, Dedicated scale, Private compliance work) and GTM focus over the next quarter. Recent signals: rising Dedicated demand from two enterprise customers, a latency regression on a model family, and a requests spike in APAC regions. This doc surfaces candidate objectives, measurable key results, and suggested tradeoffs for discussion.
company_objectives_and_key_results: O1 — Deliver predictable inference economics for mid-market customers; KR1: Reduce 95th percentile per-request token cost by 18% for hosted-api workloads; KR2: Publish 3 quantization/packaging profiles with verified quality curves; KR3: Close Dedicated capacity beta with two paid customers and SLA terms.

O2 — Improve platform reliability and graceful degradation; KR1: Restore model-family latency SLO to 99.9% for <=150ms tier; KR2: Implement automated fallback routing for top-5 customer routes; KR3: Reduce P2/P1 incident count by 40% quarter over quarter.

O3 — Accelerate private deployments and compliance readiness; KR1: Deliver VPC onboarding playbook and automation for 1-click KMS integration; KR2: Launch early-access on-prem installer and complete 2 pilot installs; KR3: Publish SOC2 gap remediation roadmap and timeline.

O4 — Developer-first product velocity and discovery; KR1: Ship SDK v2 with streaming/structured-output improvements and usage examples; KR2: Add 5 new curated evaluation suites and baseline results; KR3: Increase self-serve signups converting to paid within 30 days by 12%.

O5 — Company health and growth levers; KR1: Run two all-hands focused on cross-org tradeoffs and gather >200 pieces of feedback; KR2: Reduce mean time to hire for critical infra roles to 45 days; KR3: Achieve NPS > 40 for enterprise pilots.
proposed_allhands_flow_and_prompts: 10:00 — 10:10 Intro and northstar recap (CEO). 10:10 — 10:30 Priority tradeoffs panel (Product, Eng, Sales): surface the 3 worst conflicts and proposed mitigations. 10:30 — 10:50 Breakouts (mixed squads): calibrate local OKRs to company objectives. 10:50 — 11:10 Rollup + live poll on top-3 commitments. 11:10 — 11:20 Tactical asks and decision table. Prompts: 'What would you deprioritize to hit O1 by end of Q?' and 'Which two cross-team dependencies must be resolved in 2 weeks?'
exec_update_highlights_for_deck:
- Momentum: Dedicated beta has 2 paid pilots; early telemetry shows 7–12% cost variance vs benchmarking.
- Risk: Model-family A has a regression in attention kernel that increased tail latency; mitigation plan includes kernel swap + canary rollback.
- Ask: Commit 2 FTEs from serving-runtime to a 6-week reliability burst and $150k runway for Dedicated ramp infrastructure.
- Success metric to watch: Combined CPU/GPU capacity utilization < 85% at peak for Dedicated pools.
tradeoffs_and_decision_points: Tradeoff A: Shift 2 engineers from feature backlog (Optimize product) to reliability burst — benefit: hit latency SLO faster; cost: slower SDK feature delivery.
Tradeoff B: Prioritize Private deployment automation vs. expanding Hosted regions in APAC — benefit: enterprise revenue vs. broader self-serve growth.
Tradeoff C: Aggressive quantization rollout to lower cost vs. potential QA regressions on smaller tail cases — propose A/B rollout + eval harness per model family.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Underestimated Dedicated capacity ops complexity; Mitigation: run a preflight runbook and schedule a DR drill with pilot customer week 2.
Risk: All-hands ambiguity leads to low alignment; Mitigation: publish simple 1-pager decisions table 48h before event and required pre-read for leads.
Risk: Quality regression from quantization; Mitigation: automated evals + quality gates for canary cohorts and conservative fallback rules.
decisions_needed_by_executive_team: Decision 1: Approve 6-week reliability burst (headcount and $150k infra).
Decision 2: Select primary enterprise pilot (Pilot A vs Pilot B) for Dedicated ramp; recommendation: Pilot A (larger ARPA, internal security ok).
Decision 3: Approve two-week freeze on non-critical SDK surface changes during reliability burst.
